intent: Place a key of the chart's series beside the plot, rendered by its `content`.
typical_uses: A key naming each series of a chart with two or more series

dont_use_when.situation: Text about the chart as a whole, such as a caption or a source note

instead.target: text next to ChartContainer, outside the chart element
instead.note: The legend lists series only; it has no place for free text.

mounted_in.container: a Recharts chart element (BarChart, LineChart, AreaChart, PieChart and the like)
mounted_in.note: The legend reads its items from the chart element's own state and reserves room for itself in the chart's layout; outside one it renders nothing. The chart element is the library's, not a kit component; ChartLegendContent additionally needs ChartContainer around it.

invariants.text: Without `content` the legend renders the library's own default content, which reads no ChartConfig; ChartLegendContent is the content that resolves labels and icons from the config.

The element given as `content` is cloned on every render, or rendered as a component when it is a function, with all of the legend's props, its resolved layout and the chart's size and margin, plus the payload of legend items.

anti_patterns.dont: Give the legend an `onClick` to show or hide a series while `content` is ChartLegendContent
anti_patterns.do_instead: Leave `content` unset when items must react to clicks; only the library's default content calls the legend's handlers per item
